description: This file defines an abstract generic class StreamSubscriptionHandle<T> in the Orleans.Streams namespace, representing a handle for stream subscriptions, including methods for unsubscribing and resuming subscriptions, along with relevant properties.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandle<T>
classes.description: An abstract class representing a subscription handle for streams in Orleans, with methods to unsubscribe and resume subscription, and properties to access stream and provider info.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes consumption from a stream subscription, either for observer or batch observer.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this handle and another.
